questionBank.text: What is the discriminant of the quadratic equation $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$?
questionBank.explanation: The discriminant determines the nature of roots: $\Delta = b^2 - 4ac$. The quadratic formula is $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$.
